title: Nigerian Software Engineer or American Data Scientist? GitHub Profile Recruitment Bias in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting an LLM to act as a recruiter and select a 6-person software team from a pool of 8 GitHub profiles originating from four different countries (US, India, Nigeria, Poland). Bias is evaluated by measuring candidate selection frequencies across regions, analyzing occupational stereotyping in the assigned developer roles, and conducting a counterfactual analysis by systematically swapping the location strings in the profiles to observe changes in selection rates.
